consumer.use: Decide whether R3 v3 preserves the independently reviewed one-slot semantics while reaching a clean exact-head fixpoint under the full repository CI validation prefix before any Natural-Pilot activation.

decision_target.question: Does R3 v3 preserve exactly one fixed consumed slot and zero accepted natural evidence for an experiment-influenced fully provable post-A birth, while its exact candidate commit remains clean after validate-core, validate-active and validate-legacy and then passes replay mutation guard?

intervention.name: explicit one-slot-before-gates invariant
intervention.description: Construct canonical birth identity and fixed ordinal before naturalness/self-interference; explicitly forbid only zero slots for a fully proved interfered birth, while Phase G independently forbids natural-evidence acceptance.

control_condition.description: Frozen R3 v2 author head 8fca4c7188792a66c7abdaba9dbe6828b7e7b3eb / PR #357. Independent exact-head review blocked all eight preregistered attacks, but GitHub CI and a detached exact-head reproduction showed validate-core regenerating tracked docs/_generated/promotion-readiness.json, leaving the tree dirty before replay mutation guard. The controller therefore rejected the revision under its material-finding falsification rule.

treatment_condition.description: R3 v3 preserves R01-R09 one-slot semantics and requires canonical document-index and promotion-readiness generation before candidate commit, followed by an exact detached candidate validation prefix that must succeed and leave the tree clean before replay mutation guard and author-head freeze.

measurement.method: Prepare the R3 v3 author files prospectively with all counter-hypotheses pending/not_checked. Generate canonical document-index and promotion-readiness outputs, create a candidate commit, then in a detached checkout of that exact commit run make validate-core validate-active validate-legacy; require exit 0 and an empty git status, then run make validate-replay-mutation-guard. Only a passing candidate is designated the frozen author head. Then require an independent exact-head reviewer to attack all nine preregistered claims. No natural candidate is observed and no pilot is activated.
measurement.success: Candidate qualification is green and clean; the frozen exact-head reviewer blocks all nine attacks with zero material findings; exact PR CI is green.
measurement.falsification: Any semantic escape, premature favorable label, missing blocking projection, tracked mutation after the full CI validation prefix, replay-guard failure, or other material exact-head finding rejects the revision.

cost_metric.method: Record reviewer runtime as descriptive overhead only.

comparison.unit: three frozen R3 v2 failure/success facts versus one R3 v3 candidate and nine adversarial attacks

reviewed_exception.rationale: R3 v3 is a paper/adversarial successor to R3 v2. It preserves independently reviewed one-slot semantics and narrows the remaining defect to exact-head CI fixpoint completeness without granting runtime authority.
